notes: v657 - fixes the Market Radar strip displaying wrongly on a computer, where the evidence line appeared cut in half. The 'Market Radar' label and its chips were pinned floating over the strip with a solid background behind them, so anything that reached that corner was painted over. On a phone the label already sat in the normal flow and the problem never appeared there. It now does the same on every screen size, which removes the overlap rather than nudging it somewhere else. Checked by measuring the actual positions in a browser at eight widths from 390px to 1920px. Display only - no behaviour, rules or numbers changed. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
